name: trigger-eval
purpose: Evaluate automatic skill activation on positive architectural prompts and keyword-sharing near-miss negative prompts.

cases.prompt: Write a concise Architecture Decision Record (ADR) choosing between synchronous thumbnail generation inside the 300ms upload API vs. offloading it to our existing worker queue with a 30s freshness SLA, including cost drivers and reconsideration triggers.

Should our order confirmation service dispatch customer notifications via an async queue or a synchronous HTTP call when peak traffic jumps 10x? Compare both options against worker outage recovery and retry amplification.

Our checkout service calls Stripe synchronously inside the order DB transaction and retries 3x on timeout. Inspect orders/service.py and payments/client.py to prevent duplicate charges and design the minimal outbox and reconciliation boundary.

We have 90-day active v1 mobile clients that only understand pending and completed statuses while v2 needs split shipments. Plan a zero-downtime expand-migrate-contract rollout with a cutover barrier and a safe rollback boundary.

Review our six-dependency sequential checkout path and job queue capacity math for tail-latency spikes: each worker finishes 40 jobs/s with a 0.2 transient failure rate, one worker is down during a 300/s burst, and operators want to just enlarge queue storage.
Design a greenfield multi-tenant webhook delivery platform from scratch. We have no repo yet; clarify or bound the delivery guarantees, tenant fairness, capacity estimates, and abuse controls.

Compare AWS SQS FIFO vs. Azure Service Bus Sessions for strict per-order ordering and 4-day outage replay. Verify current retention, throughput, and message-size limits from official vendor documentation before recommending one.

Run a 45-minute mock system design interview for a multi-region nearby-friends location service at 5M DAU. Push back on my capacity estimates and privacy boundaries, then grade my reasoning at the end.

We are migrating our UI design system from Tailwind v3 CSS variables to v4 @theme tokens. Review components/Button.tsx and styles/tokens.css, update the token mapping, and verify responsive spacing across breakpoints.
Migrate our CI pipeline in .github/workflows/*.yml from actions/checkout@v3 and Ubuntu 20.04 runners to v4 and Ubuntu 24.04, and review any deprecated Node 16 flags in the workflow scripts.
I have a senior engineer behavioral interview tomorrow. Review my STAR stories about a production outage I coordinated last year and help me tighten the 2-minute spoken summary.
Following our already-approved ADR-014 in docs/adr/014.md, implement the GET /v1/invoices pagination endpoint in routes/invoices.py and add unit tests matching our existing repository pattern.

Review this single PostgreSQL reporting query in reports/daily_totals.sql that scans 2M rows and suggest a composite CREATE INDEX with EXPLAIN ANALYZE without changing table ownership or service architecture.
Fix the off-by-one UTC date parsing bug in utils/date_format.py where leap-day timestamps raise ValueError, and run the existing unit test file to confirm it passes.
The primary checkout submit button in components/CheckoutButton.css wraps awkwardly next to the spinner icon on 375px mobile screens. Fix the flexbox alignment and padding.
Bump eslint and @typescript-eslint/parser to the latest minor versions in package.json and update deprecated rule names in eslint.config.mjs so npm run lint passes.
Design the execution boundary, token/step budget, and idempotent side-effect guardrails for a multi-step customer-support AI agent calling billing APIs.
Trace the call graph from CheckoutController through OrderService and PaymentClient in this repo to find synchronous tail-latency coupling and unguarded external effects.
Read incidents/2026-09-retry-storm.md and turn the contributing causes into architectural remediation gates with quantitative abort thresholds and repair owners.
Our B2B SaaS shares one PostgreSQL cluster and worker pool across enterprise and free tiers. Design tenant isolation, per-tenant fairness quotas, and shard migration boundaries.
Implement the approved user-profile export task list in docs/specs/profile-export.md step by step without altering any system boundaries or schemas.
Profile parse_csv_row in parsers/csv_stream.py for memory allocations and rewrite the inner loop to cut per-row overhead by 30%.
Debug why tests/test_csv_stream.py fails with UnicodeDecodeError on Windows CRLF fixtures and fix the file open encoding.
Rewrite the greeting tone in prompts/support_welcome.txt to be shorter and clearer for end users without changing any tool definitions or agent boundaries.
